crossRefs.note: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to…
All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be…
and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds…
For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is…
Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t…
but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…
Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

translations.web: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
translations.bsb: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
translations.kjv: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
translations.asv: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.
